summary.text: [0-5] Thin dark chocolate stream drizzles onto front and rear rectangular golden-brown textured cereal bars on wooden board near white bowl of hazelnuts. Hand places small golden cereal garnish on dense zig-zags. Rear bars and hazelnut bowl remain static. [5-9] Hand lifts front bar; text "BUTTERFINGER RICE KRISPIE TREATS" overlays. Bar returns with bite taken out of corner. [9-13] Top-down silver pot on stovetop. Hand dumps tan peanut butter from small white bowl into pot with butter chunk using spoon to scrape. Text "BUTTER & PEANUT BUTTER". Bowl of cereal pieces on striped cloth visible top left. [13-16] Utensil stirs smooth tan liquid melted butter/peanut butter blend in pot. [16-24] Text "MARSHMALLOWS" overlays. White cylindrical marshmallows drop into pot. Hand stirs marshmallows into tan mixture with wooden spoon until coated/submerged. Background cereal bowl stays stationary.

[24-28] Silver pot, wooden spoon stirs melted white marshmallows and light tan liquid, forming smooth, light brown gooey blend. Streaks vanish as consistency becomes uniform.
[28-34] View shows white surface with striped cloth holding large bowl of cereal pieces top left. Clear glass bowl of yellow cereal pieces enters from bottom right. Text "RICE KRISPIES" displays as cereal pours into pot.
[34-42] Hand stirs vigorously with wooden spoon, mixing yellow cereal pieces into light brown base. Pieces coat fully, creating cohesive, stringy, sticky texture in mixture within silver pot.
[42-48] Text "CHOPPED BUTTERFINGER CANDY" appears as chopped tan/brown candy pours in. Spoon blends candy into sticky gooey cereal mass until uniform.

The thin stream of dark chocolate continues pouring onto the front rectangular cereal bar, moving from the center toward the right side. This motion adds further zig-zag lines to the chocolate pattern accumulating on the golden-brown textured surface. The white bowl of hazelnuts and rear bars remain static in the background.

The thin stream of dark chocolate shifts from the front bar to the rear rectangular cereal bar, depositing fresh lines onto the golden-brown textured surface. The front bar now displays a dense, completed zig-zag pattern of chocolate drizzles across its top.

The thin chocolate stream disappears, replaced by a hand entering from the top right holding a small piece of golden cereal. The hand positions the garnish over the front rectangular cereal bar, which is covered in dense chocolate zig-zags. The rear bar and white bowl of hazelnuts remain static in the background.

The hand releases the small piece of golden cereal, dropping it onto the front rectangular cereal bar. The garnish lands on the chocolate drizzle in the center. The fingers remain visible above the bar as the topping settles. The rear bar and white bowl of hazelnuts remain static in the background.

The hand reaches down and grasps the sides of the front rectangular cereal bar. Fingers wrap around the golden-brown textured treat covered in chocolate drizzle. The hand lifts the bar off the wooden board. Large white text reading "BUTTERFINGER RICE KRISPIE TREATS" appears centered over the scene.

The hand lifts the front rectangular cereal bar completely off the wooden board, holding it up in the air. The large white text overlay reading "BUTTERFINGER RICE KRISPIE TREATS" remains centered on the screen. The background bowl and rear bars stay static as the treat is elevated for display.

The hand and white text overlay disappear. The front rectangular cereal bar rests on the wooden board again, now featuring a large bite taken out of the front right corner. The chocolate drizzle and golden garnish remain on the textured surface of the remaining treat. The white bowl of hazelnuts stays in the background.

The scene cuts to a top-down view of a silver pot on a stovetop. A hand holds a small white bowl containing tan peanut butter over the pot while a spoon rests inside the mixture. White text reading "BUTTER & PEANUT BUTTER" appears centered on the screen. In the top left corner, a bowl of cereal pieces sits on a striped cloth next to the pot.

The white text overlay disappears as the hand tilts the small white bowl vertically to dump the peanut butter into the silver pot. A spoon scrapes the mixture out of the bowl, adding it to the chunk of butter already melting at the bottom. The bowl of cereal pieces remains visible in the top left corner on the striped cloth.

The right hand moves the spoon from the small white bowl into the silver pot to scrape the mixture. The text overlay disappears. The left hand holds the now-empty white bowl to the left of the pot. A bowl of cereal pieces remains visible in the top left corner on the striped cloth.

The right hand uses a spoon to scrape the remaining peanut butter from the small white bowl into the silver pot, depositing it next to the melting butter chunk. The left hand holds the bowl steady while the bowl of cereal pieces remains visible in the top left corner.
